# Email Sift Rubric

Sift labels new Gmail by importance on a schedule, and reads this doc in full before every run. It's my definition of what matters.

## Labels

Every label sift applies, and when.

| Label | When sift applies it |
|---|---|
| AI/Bulk | Mass mail I wouldn't miss if it were archived unread: sales, offers, and promotions |
| AI/Receipt | The message is a receipt for something I bought, or carries one. A sale, an offer, or a promotion from a store I buy from is not a receipt and gets none |
| AI/Newsletter | It works as a newsletter, whatever it calls itself |
